speaker: mikezaro
text: So Dennis, and I missed the first part of the references. I was talking to Eileen. She's gonna disconnect and try reconnecting, but so I know that we had two officers, officer Babcock and officer Mundell. And officer Dobson. And Dobson. What we look at is the reasons they're leaving and if there's any common themes to why they're leaving and there really isn't. And we tried to have very open and clear discussions with each of them and they all left for very different reasons. And all I can do is take them at face value when they give the reasons. For Jamin Dobson, he said it was partly financial and partly for family reasons because he has a child custody thing going on and it's going through a separation and it just geographically worked better for him. Officer Babcock left to go be a part of the fire services, which is something that he wanted to do. And the day after he left, wished he was still here. And that's one of the topics that we have for discussion on the agenda today. And then Kirsten Mundell was really the frustrating one for me. She, and that was a week before she was supposed to start the academy. She came to us and just said that it really wasn't her passion. And she was worried about wasting our time or going through with it and not doing a good job and said she just didn't have the drive to do it that she thought she would or did at one time. And we had several different people try to talk to her to see if there was something more to it. And we never got anything other than that, that it just wasn't something she wanted to do anymore. I even tried to convince her just to finish the academy and then she could be a lateral for another department. I just wanted her to be successful. It didn't have to be here, but she didn't even want to do that. I mean, she was done. And I gave her, I'd received notice on, I think December 28th, something like that. And I, going into the New Year's Eve, New Year's Day weekend, I told her just to think about it till Monday. And I presented all these other scenarios for her and come Monday, she still just did not have the interest in it. So it's unfortunate. If there is something more there, we couldn't find it. And that's with any of the candidates. So it's hard to say that there's any one reason why they would be leaving.
